headline: Crude Oil Holds Near $100 as Middle East Conflict Escalates
summary: December WTI crude oil futures fluctuated near $99.29 per barrel as threats against regional energy and data infrastructure heightened geopolitical risk premiums.
why: Crude oil is a vital global energy commodity whose price directly impacts inflation rates and corporate transport costs worldwide.

impacts.name: Crude Oil
impacts.why: Heightened risks of military strikes on energy infrastructure in the Middle East sustain supply disruption concerns.

why_moved: Tensions and potential retaliatory attacks targeting oil refineries maintained high supply-risk premiums in crude trading.
